steps.title: Два предложения — две разные задачи
steps.html:
I downloaded it four years ago. — завершённое событие в названное время. Время закончилось.

I have played it almost every week since. — период начался в прошлом и ещё не закрыт.

I have still not finished the hardest level. — важен результат сейчас, история не закончена.

steps.title: В каком предложении время закончено?
options: I have been to that cinema three times.
I went to that cinema on Friday.
I have never been to that cinema.
steps.answer: I went to that cinema on Friday.
steps.why: On Friday называет законченное время — нужен Past Simple.

steps.title: Какая форма и когда
steps.html:
ФормаКогда используемСлова-маркеры
Past simpleзавершённое событие в законченное времяyesterday, last night, in 2012, four years ago, when I was nine
Present perfectопыт до настоящего момента, время не названоever, never, before, three times
Present perfectпериод, который ещё не закончилсяfor four years, since 2012, so far, this week
Present perfectпрошлое действие, результат которого важен сейчасalready, yet, just, still not

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
Время зависит от временного отрезка, а не от самого события. Спросите: этот период закончился или ещё идёт?

This morning в одиннадцать утра — Present Perfect (I've had three coffees this morning), а в восемь вечера — Past Simple. Слова те же; отрезок закрылся.

been и gone — разные: She has been to Lagos (съездила и вернулась). She has gone to Lagos (она там сейчас).

steps.title: The best game I've ever played
steps.html:
Прочитайте один раз. Заметьте, где автор переходит с have played на played.

I have played video games since I was nine, and I have never been very good at any of them. So it surprised me as much as anyone when a game made in Lagos became the one I could not put down.

Maliyo Games started in Nigeria in 2012. Their titles are small, cheap and hand-held: you play them on the bus. In Mosquito Smasher you defend a room; in Okada Ride you dash through the streets of Lagos on a motorbike, avoiding cars, trucks and potholes. That last one is the game I mean. I downloaded it four years ago, I have played it almost every week since, and I have still not finished the hardest level.

What makes it work is not the graphics. It is that the streets are real. The company set out to showcase African culture to the world through games, and the traffic, the noise and the sellers at the roadside are all recognizable to anyone who has been to the city. A growing middle class looking for entertainment has helped Nigerian games and music sweep across the continent. Last year Nigerians bought an astonishing 21.5 million mobile phones; most of Maliyo's fans now log in from Brazil, India and the US.

I have shown the game to about twenty people. Four of them became addicted; the rest said it was silly and went back to their own screens. That is fair. The plot is thin, the soundtrack is repetitive, and I have never once recommended it to anyone who does not already like arcade games.

But when someone asks me which game I have enjoyed most, I do not talk about the expensive ones I finished and forgot. I talk about a two-megabyte game about a motorbike, which I have played for four years and have still not beaten.

The best game I've ever played

I have played video games since I was nine, and I have never been very good at any of them. So it surprised me as much as anyone when a game made in Lagos became the one I could not put down.

Maliyo Games started in Nigeria in 2012. Their titles are small, cheap and hand-held: you play them on the bus. In Mosquito Smasher you defend a room; in Okada Ride you dash through the streets of Lagos on a motorbike, avoiding cars, trucks and potholes. That last one is the game I mean. I downloaded it four years ago, I have played it almost every week since, and I have still not finished the hardest level.

What makes it work is not the graphics. It is that the streets are real. The company set out to showcase African culture to the world through games, and the traffic, the noise and the sellers at the roadside are all recognizable to anyone who has been to the city. A growing middle class looking for entertainment has helped Nigerian games and music sweep across the continent. Last year Nigerians bought an astonishing 21.5 million mobile phones; most of Maliyo's fans now log in from Brazil, India and the US.

I have shown the game to about twenty people. Four of them became addicted; the rest said it was silly and went back to their own screens. That is fair. The plot is thin, the soundtrack is repetitive, and I have never once recommended it to anyone who does not already like arcade games.

But when someone asks me which game I have enjoyed most, I do not talk about the expensive ones I finished and forgot. I talk about a two-megabyte game about a motorbike, which I have played for four years and have still not beaten.

steps.title: Как говорить об опыте и о конкретном случае
Ответьте вслух.
items: Какая лучшая игра или фильм на вашей памяти? Когда впервые увидели?
Как давно вы её знаете и как часто возвращаетесь?
Есть ли то, что все советуют, а вы так и не попробовали?

steps.title: Теперь опишите это одним высказыванием. Запишите себя.
steps.sub: Используйте Present Perfect для всего периода и Past Simple для первого раза.
items: I first saw / played it in … , when I … .
I've … it … times since then, and I still haven't … .

steps.title: Урок 14 пройден
items: Я выбираю между Present Perfect и Past Simple.
Я говорю об опыте с ever, never и yet.
Я могу описать хорошо знакомую игру или фильм.
Я по-прежнему верно использую -ing и инфинитив.
